public_status: Unconfirmed candidate signal, ready for expert review
novelty_status: no match in the sources checked
novelty_note: No ephemeris match among 46,472 KOI, DR25 TCE and Kepler eclipsing binary catalogue entries. Non-KOI DR24 TCEs and the literature are unchecked, so novelty is unproven.
duration_note: Search-grid value (0.195 d), not a fit.
radius_conditions: Only if KIC 4916729 is the host (R* 0.64 Gaia to 1.15 R_sun; depth 984-1157 ppm).
host_test: Preferred over the 5.2 arcsec neighbour (difference-image test 5/5 assigned; per-star brightness test 1072 +/- 117 vs -37 +/- 39 ppm). The brighter KIC 4916733 at 32 arcsec remains unresolved as a possible source (point-source model preferred, controls 6/6).
limitations: A blend within 1-2 arcsec and an equal-depth eclipsing binary at twice the period (30.47 d) are not excluded.

Figure panel (b) uses a display normalisation and shows an apparent brightening of order +0.7-1.5 ppt near phase 0.5, while the search measured -15 +/- 74 ppm at phase 0.5; panel (b) must not be cited as proof of no secondary eclipse.
figure_caveat: Panel (b) uses a display normalisation and shows an apparent brightening of order +0.7-1.5 ppt near phase 0.5, while the search measured -15 +/- 74 ppm at phase 0.5. Do not read panel (b) as proof of no secondary eclipse.
open_questions: Far-wing PSF calibration or resolved photometry during transit; AO below 2 arcsec; a spectrum.
